func Map93[T any, U any](in []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	out := make([]U, 0, len(in))
	for _, v := range in {
		out = append(out, f(v))
	}
	return out
}

type Number93 interface {
	~int | ~int64 | ~float64
}

func (s *Stack93[T]) Push(v T) { s.items = append(s.items, v) }

func run192(ch chan int, done <-chan struct{}) (total int, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("recovered: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		switch {
		case i%2 == 0:
			continue
		case i > 7:
			break
		default:
			total += i
		}
	}
	for v := range ch {
		select {
		case <-done:
			return total, nil
		default:
			total += v
		}
	}
	go func(n int) { _ = n }(total)
	if total > 100 {
		goto end
	}
	total++
end:
	return total, nil
}

			err = fmt.Errorf("recovered: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {

			continue
		case i > 7:
			break
		default:
			total += i
		}

		select {
		case <-done:
			return total, nil
		default:
			total += v
		}
	}
	go func(n int) { _ = n }(total)
	if total > 100 {
		goto end
	}
	total++
end:
	return total, nil
}

func run671(ch chan int, done <-chan struct{}) (total int, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("recovered: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		switch {
		case i%2 == 0:
			continue
		case i > 7:
			break
		default:
			total += i
		}
	}
	for v := range ch {
		select {
		case <-done:
			return total, nil
		default:
			total += v
		}
	}
	go func(n int) { _ = n }(total)
	if total > 100 {
		goto end
	}
	total++
end:
	return total, nil
}

	out := make([]U, 0, len(in))
	for _, v := range in {
		out = append(out, f(v))
	}
	return out
}
